commit.message:
Support TLS with self-signed certificates for LLMInferenceService (#742)

* Support TLS for LLMInferenceService

Signed-off-by: Pierangelo Di Pilato <pierdipi@redhat.com>

* Automatically create DestinationRules for TLS traffic from Gateway

For
- Gateway -> vllm (or routing sidecar) and
- Gateway -> inference-scheduler
we need to configure Istio to (for now) `InsecureSkipVerify`
certificates so that we can use self-signed certificates while
having e2e TLS encryption.

commit.message:
Support LWS-based multi node with data parallelism of MoE models (#716)

* Support LWS-based multi node with data parallelism of MoE models

For more details, please read:
- https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mSYsWQEbp4Oq50ghFWUun7OgagbuUJivAC8Ds-pu-xU/edit?tab=t.0
- https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1_nSxtf0h1lO3EySk5FEP9Neqym9h3VYGRsMt_ZnRaGw/edit?slide=id.p#slide=id.p
- https://docs.google.com/document/d/19dAjS6gqYWRJ0FQMYCwG-XJHIgWwmvsS-pBynwPHhwo/edit?tab=t.0

Ref: RHOAIENG-28170

Signed-off-by: Pierangelo Di Pilato <pierdipi@redhat.com>

* Fix InferencePool selector for multi node and address reviews

- InferencePool selector now takes into account the multi node case
  sends requests to either leader or worker with index 0
- Addressed review comments
- Remove GPU presets as they are not generic enough to work with
  multi node cases and we can re-think the approach as future
  iteration
- Add LWS to scheme and watch

Signed-off-by: Pierangelo Di Pilato <pierdipi@redhat.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Pierangelo Di Pilato <pierdipi@redhat.com>

commit.message:
Implement authorization for Raw InferenceGraphs (#499) (#532)

* Implement authorization for Raw InferenceGraphs

Authorization is implemented by using the TokenReview and the SubjectAccessReview Kubernetes APIs. A Middleware function is setup when some arguments are specified that trigger plugging-in the middleware func.

Some additional reconciliation is added toInferenceGraph controller to:
* Switch to a different ServiceAccount so that privileges for using the cluster APIs are granted.
* Creating the needed ServiceAccount for the auth-protected InferenceGraph to run.
* Managing a ClusterRoleBinding to give the required privileges for auth verification.



* Feedback: Jooho

Fix comment

* Fix unit test



---------

Signed-off-by: Edgar Hernández <23639005+israel-hdez@users.noreply.github.com>
